SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: "I never think of the future. It comes soon enough."

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: - Albert Einstein

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
This is the Kousaka household, located somewhere 
in Chiba.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
In this residence, worried maidens assemble, 
seeking answers from the master of life, every night.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Now then, I wonder who tonight's guest will be...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Sup!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: You're here...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Huh? It's just a normal old man.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Not quite what I imagined, but... you gonna give me 
some advice, old man?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: What's with the attitude? I don't like it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Uehh... You seem super cranky...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: I seem cranky because of your attitude.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Is that the attitude you have with your superiors, 
even as a joke?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Whatever. I act properly at school and work just 
fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: It's my off day now. O.F.F. Understand?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Say old man, why don't you lose the scary face 
and relax a little?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: This is my resting face.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Are you for real?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Isn't that kind of a waste?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: A... waste?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
I mean, it's like even if you drink juice or alcohol, 
you'd have the same reaction after.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: "...It's good." Like that, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Grr...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: You have a wife?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Of course.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Don't you feel bad for her?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
She puts in effort into making a home-cooked meal, 
but you react as if you just had a bento from the 
convenience store. Won't she lose motivation?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Grr...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Hah! ...Bulls-eye? Seriously? Pffthahaha!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: ...I'll bear that in mind.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Ah, my bad, don't be so sad.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
You've got your own good points, right? 
...Somewhere.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
You... Who do you even think you are? Did you not 
come here for advice?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Hmm... Advice, huh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
I might not look it, but I'm an idol, my popularity's 
been on the rise, too? Nothing's really bothering me 
at the moment.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Actually, Kanako doesn't tend to worry about things 
in general.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Hmph... Happy-go-lucky person, aren't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Ah! Did you just take me for a fool, old man?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Geez, there are so many people out there that 
treat me like a childish idiot.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Is this what worrying feels like?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: ...I've got nothing to say.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [font_size=15]Not good... If I keep talking to this girl, I'll go crazy.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
...If you have no business, then leave. If you don't 
want to leave, then let's have a proper discussion.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Haa? What kind of order is that? Besides, I already 
told you my worries anyway!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: That's hardly an issue worth talking about.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
You get treated like an idiot because you like to 
fool around. If you're doing it on purpose, then be 
glad that it's working.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: If not, then you're actually a real idiot.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Nope. I'm an idiot but I'm not stupid, either.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
I carefully think things through, even if it doesn't 
seem that wa-

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Well, maybe I don't think enough...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: D-Don't glare at me like that!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Ah, right, right! Even Kanako has something that 
bothers her! I do, I do!!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Ohh...? Well, let's hear it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Not so much a worry, more like I'm not sure what's 
the best thing to do...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
I have entrance exams coming up next year. But, I 
don't know what I want to do for a career after 
graduating.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Hmm. A career...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: I'm not too sure about how my future should go.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: But, you know, I really don't want to go to school.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
So I'm lost on if I should go on to high school. 
Seriously.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Is this really something that can be decided 
through someone else's advice?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: "If you really don't want to go, then don't."

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Isn't that the gist of what an adult would say?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Mmm...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
But guess what, now the problem lies in what else I 
should do if I don't go.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
I feel that adults shouldn't act as if they know 
everything and give some vague suggestions.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
That is something you have to think about for 
yourself.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Hmm, well yeah, but... I don't really know, so what 
other choice do I have?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
I don't know what I should do, but I know I'll cause 
trouble for others if I ask them.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Put yourself in my shoes, being pushed away and 
told to "do as you please".

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Well... Certainly, I admit you have a point.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: ...Do you have any goals in life?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Oh, you bet! I want to become a top idol and be 
even more pampered!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
But all that would go away when I get old like a 
granny, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
To be pampered forever, ain't that super difficult 
though?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
You can't do anything if you're stuck worrying only 
in the short term.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: No no, I've got a much more grand ultimate goal.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Ultimate goal...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: To become a rich lady. Filthy rich. Obviously, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Ah~ I wanna be so rich~ ...Isn't there an easy way 
to earn money?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [font_size=33]Of course there isn't![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Figures... Even I understand that, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Why are you fussing over money?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
It's not that I'm fussing over it, but... you know what, 
maybe I am?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Well, it's enough to have just the bare minimum, 
but it's hard to earn more, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: ...This is a secret from my friends, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: ...Hmm?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: I want to be responsible for myself.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: That's a great way of thinking.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Right? There's a lot of circumstances for me too...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Mostly, I don't want to be a burden to my sister, 
something like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Hmm...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
I know there's no easy way to make money, I'm 
already in my third year of middle school.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
I know fully well how difficult it would be to do 
something with just my own power.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Watching my sister trying her best without even 
sleeping, I understand it even if I don't want to.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
To earn a living doing what you like is such a 
magnificent thing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
But, she looks so happy, I think she's amazing too... 
It's a bit sickening, though...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
I want to have fun working just like she does, and I 
don't want to get in the way of what she wants to 
do.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: So... What would be the best thing for me to do?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Let's see...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
To put it bluntly, there's nothing I can say to you 
right now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [font_size=28]What!?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: ...For now, go take a bath and sleep it off.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
If you've decided you want to become an idol, then 
do so.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
You don't want to burden your sister? You want a 
way to make just enough money to live? 
Furthermore, you want to be pampered forever...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[font_size=28]Say that only after you've reached idol 
status!![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Hey, hey, aren't you really just pushing me away 
then?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
I'm not pushing you away. I'm saying you're not 
qualified to worry about that right now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Qualified? ...The heck you talking about?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
You're trying to build a bridge before you've 
reached the river. There is no way you can move 
forward like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
First you have to make a choice. Then worry about 
what comes after. Think about how you should 
move forward.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Shouldn't I worry so that I can make the right 
choice?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
In your case, you will have to decide right then and 
there, without time to worry about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
There should be many things you can do before 
that happens.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Until the time comes for you to make that critical 
decision, you should go down the path you believe 
in.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
If you aren't fully prepared when the time comes... 
you will definitely regret it later.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Even I... don't want to have any regrets.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Of course. The only person who can betray yourself 
is you.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
For example, someone or certain circumstances 
betrayed you. That's a result of you believing in 
them, which betrayed you.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Remember that well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: That's deep...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
It's incredibly realistic that I'm troubled now. Old 
man, you watch too many detective dramas? Aren't 
you too sentimental?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
What's important here is your future. You don't 
need to joke around.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: I-I see...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Hehe... Hahaha...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Mmm... Somehow, I'm a bit happy how this all 
turned out.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
A good old man taking things this seriously, just for 
me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Thanks, old man. I'm all refreshed now after that 
harsh lecture.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Well wait and see, before long I'll be on television 
during tea time.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: No problem, you're only as good as your word.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Of course, don't underestimate Kanako!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
But you know... If I end up lost over what to do 
again...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: I might come back here.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Hmph. Very well. Have some resolve when the time 
comes.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
...She's gone, huh? ...She's unexpectedly got a 
backbone.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Today's moral lesson!!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[font_size=30]Don't worry for the sake of worrying!! 
The answer lies within yourself!![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
--And so, Daisuke has guided the path of another 
lost maiden. Let us meet on another moonlit night.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Honey...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: What is it, Dear?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Nothing... The mackerel in miso soup for dinner... it 
was delicious.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Hehehe, thanks. That was frozen food, though.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: ...Mmm.
